name: RunInvariant governed Agent Run subject protocol
transport: canonical UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one LF per message over stdin/stdout
canonical_profile: RFC 8785 object sorting, non-negative safe integers, no duplicate keys, no unpaired surrogates
request_binding: SHA-256 of canonical AgentRunRequest bytes without LF, matching TerminalRunReceipt.body.request_digest
transcript_binding: SHA-256 of concatenated call and reply frames including LF, excluding start and terminal
response_binding: packet records SHA-256 of exact terminal frame including LF
signing: public fixture Ed25519 key signs canonical start_digest, request_digest and receipt_digest object plus LF; separate from GAAP DSSE attestation
terminal: one terminal frame followed by EOF and exit 0; the post-terminal probe must be refused with exit 1 and no further stdout
crash_boundary: process death never counts as a terminal receipt; no persistence or resume claim
clock_profile: monotonic cumulative adapter elapsed milliseconds from run start zero; executor usage is counted separately; observations follow operations
start_binding: SHA-256 of exact start frame including LF
